cards.name: SmartEarn
cards.welcome_benefit: Rs.500 cashback on spending Rs.10,000 within first 90 days
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 0% fuel convenience fee at HPCL for transactions below Rs.5,000
cards.reward_exclusions: No points on fuel, insurance, utilities, cash transactions and EMI conversion at POS
cards.eligibility: Min annual income Rs.4.5L (salaried) / Rs.6L (self-employed); select cities only
cards.notes: Entry-level Amex. 10X partner bonus capped at 500 bonus points/month and 5X Amazon bonus capped at 250 bonus points/month (bonus_monthly_cap 750 is the sum of the two separate caps). rupee_per_point 0.25 reflects standalone statement-credit/catalog value; pooling MR points with an MRCC/Gold Charge unlocks 18K/24K Gold Collection redemptions worth ~Rs.0.50/point. NOT open to new applicants as of Jul 2026: Amex India paused all new card applications in Mar 2025 for a platform migration and, on resuming in Sep 2025, reopened only Platinum Charge and Platinum Reserve. RBI history: Amex was barred from onboarding new customers 1 May 2021 (data-localisation non-compliance); ban lifted 24 Aug 2022.

cards.name: Membership Rewards Credit Card (MRCC)
cards.welcome_benefit: 4,000 bonus MR points on paying joining fee and spending Rs.15,000 within 90 days; 5,000 bonus points on first-year renewal
cards.milestone_benefits: Monthly (enrolment required): 1,000 bonus MR points for making 4 transactions of Rs.1,500 or more in a calendar month; additional 1,000 bonus MR points on spending Rs.20,000 in the same month (max 2,000 bonus points/month)
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 0% fuel convenience fee at HPCL below Rs.5,000; 1% for Rs.5,000+
cards.reward_exclusions: No points on fuel, insurance, utilities, cash transactions and EMI conversion at POS
cards.eligibility: Min annual income Rs.4.5L (salaried) / Rs.6L (self-employed); select cities only
cards.notes: The 4x Rs.1,500 monthly-bonus threshold was raised from Rs.1,000 to Rs.1,500 effective Apr 2024. rupee_per_point 0.5 assumes 18K/24K Gold Collection redemptions (18,000 pts -> Taj voucher Rs.9,000 = Rs.0.50/pt; 24,000 pts -> Taj Rs.14,000 = Rs.0.58/pt best case) or 1:1 Marriott Bonvoy transfers (~Rs.0.50/pt); standard catalog redemptions are worth much less (~Rs.0.25). Renewal fee 50% waived at Rs.90K-1.5L spend, 100% at Rs.1.5L+. NOT open to new applicants as of Jul 2026 (Mar-2025 application pause for platform migration; only Platinum Charge/Reserve reopened Sep 2025). RBI history: new-customer onboarding banned 1 May 2021 over data-localisation non-compliance, lifted 24 Aug 2022.

cards.name: Platinum Travel Credit Card
cards.welcome_benefit: 10,000 MR points on spending Rs.15,000 within 90 days
cards.milestone_benefits: Per cardmembership year: 7,500 bonus MR points at Rs.1.9L spend; 10,000 bonus MR points at Rs.4L spend; 22,500 additional bonus MR points plus Taj Stay voucher worth Rs.10,000 (Taj/SeleQtions/Vivanta) at Rs.7L spend. Milestone points redeemable on Platinum Travel Collection
cards.lounge_access: 8 complimentary domestic lounge visits/year (max 2 per quarter); complimentary Priority Pass membership (US$99 fee waived, visits chargeable)
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 0% fuel convenience fee at HPCL for transactions below Rs.5,000
cards.reward_exclusions: No points on fuel, insurance, utilities, cash transactions and EMI conversion at POS
cards.eligibility: Min annual income Rs.6L; select cities only
cards.notes: Milestone structure shown is the revamped version on the official page as of Jul 2026 (older reviews cite 15,000 pts at Rs.1.9L and 25,000 pts + Taj Rs.10,000 at Rs.4L; verify at application). No renewal-fee waiver; milestones are the fee justification. rupee_per_point 0.5 assumes Platinum Travel Collection / Marriott-transfer style redemptions (~Rs.0.50/pt, up to ~Rs.0.58 via 24K Gold Collection Taj vouchers). NOT open to new applicants as of Jul 2026 (Mar-2025 application pause; only Platinum Charge/Reserve reopened Sep 2025). RBI history: onboarding ban 1 May 2021 (data localisation), lifted 24 Aug 2022.

cards.name: Gold Card (Charge)
cards.welcome_benefit: 6,000 bonus MR points on paying first-year fee and spending Rs.10,000 within 90 days
cards.milestone_benefits: Monthly: 1,000 bonus MR points for making 6 transactions of Rs.1,000 or more in a calendar month
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 0% fuel convenience fee at HPCL for transactions below Rs.5,000
cards.reward_exclusions: No points on insurance and cash transactions; no points on fuel (petrol/diesel/CNG at OMCs) effective 12 Jun 2025; utilities (electricity/water/gas) DO earn 1 pt/Rs.50 but capped at 10,000 points/month
cards.eligibility: Min annual income Rs.6L; select cities only
cards.notes: Charge card: no preset spending limit, balance payable in full monthly; annual_fee is the actual fee (Rs.1,000 yr 1, Rs.4,500 yr 2+), no spend-based waiver. Famous for 18K/24K Gold Collection: 18,000 pts -> Taj voucher Rs.9,000 (Rs.0.50/pt), 24,000 pts -> Taj Rs.14,000 (Rs.0.58/pt) - basis for rupee_per_point 0.5. Devaluation: fuel earning (previously 1/Rs.50 capped 5,000 pts/mo) removed 12 Jun 2025; utilities earning capped 10,000 pts/mo since 1 Jul 2021. NOT open to new applicants as of Jul 2026 (Mar-2025 application pause; only Platinum Charge/Reserve reopened Sep 2025). RBI history: onboarding ban 1 May 2021 (data localisation), lifted 24 Aug 2022.

cards.name: Platinum Reserve Credit Card
cards.welcome_benefit: 11,000 bonus MR points on spending Rs.30,000 within 90 days
cards.milestone_benefits: Monthly vouchers (movie/online shopping) worth Rs.1,000 per month (Rs.12,000/year) on spending Rs.50,000 in the month
cards.lounge_access: Complimentary domestic lounge access in India; Priority Pass membership (US$99 fee waived) with up to 2 complimentary international lounge visits/year
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 0% fuel convenience fee at HPCL for transactions below Rs.5,000
cards.reward_exclusions: No points on fuel, insurance, utilities, cash transactions and EMI conversion at POS
cards.eligibility: Min annual income Rs.6L; select cities only
cards.notes: One of only two Amex cards OPEN to new applicants as of Jul 2026 (Apply button live; applications reopened Sep 2025 after the Mar-2025 platform-migration pause; one Apr-2026 report claims only Platinum Charge is open, but the official page still shows Apply Now). 100% renewal-fee waiver at Rs.10L annual spend. Perks: complimentary Taj Epicure, Accor Plus Explorer, EazyDiner Prime memberships; golf 2x/month at 32+ courses (needs Rs.50K monthly spend). rupee_per_point 0.5 via 18K/24K Gold Collection or 1:1 Marriott Bonvoy transfers. RBI history: onboarding ban 1 May 2021 (data localisation), lifted 24 Aug 2022.

cards.name: Platinum Card (Charge)
cards.welcome_benefit: Welcome gift worth up to ~Rs.60,000: cardmember's choice from a voucher catalogue (e.g. Taj/luxury vouchers) after paying annual fee and Rs.50,000 net spend in first 2 months
cards.milestone_benefits: Rewards Xcelerator: up to 20X points on curated luxury/lifestyle brands
cards.lounge_access: 1,550+ lounges in 140+ countries: Centurion Lounges, Priority Pass (unlimited for primary), Delta Sky Club, Escape Lounges, plus domestic partner lounges in India
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 0% fuel convenience fee at HPCL for transactions below Rs.5,000
cards.reward_exclusions: No points on fuel, insurance, utilities, cash transactions and EMI conversion
cards.eligibility: Min annual income Rs.25L (salaried) / Rs.15L (self-employed); select metros/cities
cards.notes: Charge card: no preset spending limit; annual_fee is the actual fee (Rs.66,000 + GST), no waiver. Earn 1 MR/Rs.40 domestic (2.5/Rs.100), 3X on international spend. rupee_per_point 0.5 via 1:1 Marriott Bonvoy / airline partner transfers and Gold Collection; Rewards Xcelerator and sweet-spot transfers can exceed this. Elite statuses: Marriott Bonvoy Gold, Hilton Honors Gold, Taj Reimagined Epicure, Radisson Premium, Accor Plus. One of only two Amex cards OPEN to new applicants as of Jul 2026 (Apply Now live; reopened Sep 2025 after Mar-2025 platform-migration pause). RBI history: onboarding ban 1 May 2021 (data localisation), lifted 24 Aug 2022.
